name: How does AKN Design Group ensure the quality and longevity of a deck construction project?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group ensure the quality and longevity of a deck construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group ensures the quality and longevity of our deck construction projects through an integrated design-build process, meticulous material selection, and expert craftsmanship. We adhere to stringent building standards and best practices, leveraging our over two decades of experience and more than 10,000 jobs completed. Our managed process provides a single point of coordination, minimizing miscommunication and ensuring consistent oversight from design planning to final walkthrough. Anthony Nusbaumer's leadership emphasizes honesty, reliability, and craftsmanship, consistently building trust, relationships, and lasting impressions with every project, guaranteeing a durable and beautiful result.
acceptedAnswer.description: We ensure deck quality and longevity through our integrated design-build process, meticulous material selection, expert craftsmanship, adherence to standards, and dedicated project oversight.
